what: Hovering a header menu item unfolds the dropdown panel below via grid-rows 0fr→1fr in .3s. Items in the panel rise from 10px below and .96 scale with a .045s stagger on back.out(1.8), and the chevron flips in .45s on back.out(2.1). On leave it waits .12s before folding — so a hand moving from the link to the panel is not lost. When folding, the items do not move and only the panel closes

options.delay: Wait time after release before folding (seconds), default .12 — 0 folds immediately
options.each: Time for one item to rise into place (s), default .42
options.--fx-dur: Duration of the panel unfolding (css variable), default .3s
options.--fx-gap: Gap between link and panel (css variable, part of the panel so it does not close as the hand passes), default 16px

use:
Company About ▾
CompanyTeam
note: On touch devices (no hover) the first tap opens the panel and the second tap follows the link. The panel’s look (dark rounded panel) is a default set by skin variables, so the consuming CSS overrides it.
